description: Select an environment the user explicitly chose when none is selected or a switch is requested, and connect to its Copilot Studio MCP service. Do not reselect an already-ready environment merely to start another task. Supply its complete ID for an access-checked lookup, or a unique display name. Selection does not change the service deployment (ring); it clears old connector setup plans, and a failed switch leaves no active online environment. This does not create a connector connection.
name: copilot_studio_select_environment
title: Connect to an environment
